question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Krishna __never find a friend__ like Sudama again.
solution:
The correct answer is '**never found a friend**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1** "**never found a friend**" is the correct substitution here.
 
• The **correct verb tense** to use in this sentence is the **past** tense, as it is referring to a **past** event.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence would be "**Krishna never found a friend like Sudama again.**"
 
• So, **option 1** is the correct choice to improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence**__: *Krishna **never found a friend** like Sudama again.*
